summary_markdown: The conversation focused on debugging an error related to calculating demographics, specifically when accessing a local development environment or production metrics. The initial error was traced back to a `ClickHouseError` regarding arrays passed to the `avgWeightedForEach` aggregate function having different sizes. It was determined that for one of three facilities within a specific campaign, demographic data was missing. A hotfix was implemented and deployed to resolve the crash on the analytics platform. Although the system stopped crashing, the metrics displayed were zero, requiring further investigation.
decisions: A hotfix was created and applied to fix the demographic calculation error in the production environment.
The issue was deemed non-critical ('не горит') but necessary for future stability.
action_items: Someone needs to investigate why the metrics displayed on the analytics platform are currently zero.
